items.name: quest-lib
items.title: Quest constants
items.description: Meta Quest browser platform constants (2D panel sizes, hit targets) and a browser-detection helper.

items.name: use-panel-size
items.title: usePanelSize
items.description: Track a container's live size with a ResizeObserver and bucket it against the Quest panel envelope, for layouts that reflow as windows resize.

items.name: quest-panel
items.title: Quest Panel
items.description: An edge-to-edge content panel sized for the Horizon OS window model, with header/body/footer parts and 48px touch targets.

items.name: panel-group
items.title: Panel Group
items.description: Responsive multi-panel layout that derives its column count from the live container width — built for side-by-side resizable Quest windows.
